summary: For HAProxy in front of platform gateway, set custom_ca_cert and gateway_main_url; the load balancer must use HTTP/1.1 (HTTP/2 unsupported) and SSL passthrough is not supported.
questions: How do I put HAProxy in front of platform gateway?
Can I use SSL passthrough with platform gateway?

answer_card.title: HAProxy in front of the gateway
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[all:vars]
custom_ca_cert=<path_to_cert_crt>
gateway_main_url=<https://load_balancer_url>
```
- Use **HTTP/1.1** to the gateway; HTTP/2 is not supported
- HAProxy **SSL passthrough** is not supported
